title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.0 Release Candidate 2
summary: Version 1.0.0 Release Candidate 2 fixes the install-from-Settings dialog being trapped behind the always-on-top Settings window. It keeps the cleaned MWB-only repository and all portable behavior from RC1 while making the optional portable-to-installed path usable.
changes: Centers the install-from-Settings dialog over its parent Settings window.
Keeps that modal installer above the always-on-top Settings window instead of leaving an unreachable disabled Settings window in front of it.
Removes the redundant taskbar button from the owned install dialog while retaining a normal taskbar entry for the true first-launch window.
Updates the program, About, diagnostics, release metadata, and documentation to version 1.0.0-rc.2.
Keeps the one-file portable and optional self-install behavior from RC1 unchanged apart from the dialog ordering repair.
testing: Run RC2 portably, open Settings > Portable, and click Install this portable copy.
Confirm the installer appears centered in front of Settings and every field and button can be used without moving the Settings window.
Open Browse and confirm the folder picker also remains reachable in front of the installer.
Cancel the installer and confirm Settings becomes responsive again.
Repeat the flow and complete installation, confirming the existing key, layout, and options move to the installed copy.
Open About and confirm the displayed product version is 1.0.0-rc.2.
Run the same RC2 EXE on both computers and briefly recheck mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, and reconnect behavior.
